name: Extra Credit
source:
The story of a geneticist, who after retiring from his job working for a madman bent on universal domination, has moved to Southwestern Florida to raise his daughter Eve, who happens to be the world first pure  human genetic clone, and teach at a local girls private school.  They live with his best friend Abere Lucifer and her younger sister Niki, the daughters of an employee of his old boss named Adao Lucifer, who runs Hell as a side job.  This small Florida town might hold some secrets though

[From [url=https://doc5252.itch.io/extra-credit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述了一位遗传学家的故事，他从为一个一心想要统治世界的疯子工作的工作中退休后，搬到佛罗里达州西南部抚养他的女儿伊芙，她恰好是世界上第一个纯人类基因克隆人，并在当地的一所女子私立学校任教。他们与他最好的朋友阿贝尔·路西法（Abere Lucifer）和她的妹妹尼基（Niki）住在一起，她们是他的前老板阿道·路西法（Adao Lucifer）的一名雇员的女儿，阿道·路西法以经营地狱为副业。这个佛罗里达小镇可能蕴藏着一些秘密
